Lisa and

Even after the funeral, the two sisters hardly spoke to each other.
Actually,
more than five years had passed since Lisa had
last met Rosa, so she didn't
know what to say.
A year later, their mother was preparing to sell their grandmother's house
and asked Rosa and Lisa to clean it out for her.
They agreed, but it was a sad
task
◆◆◆◆◆
While sorting through items, Lisa found an old recipe book hidden behind
some files・She held it up and called out, "Rosa, do you remember this?"
Rosa's
eyes widened as memories flooded back.
They
spent hours looking through
the
pages,
reading
the handwritten

Each recipe brought back a
memory.
There were notes like #@Marco's favorite" next to the apple pie recipe
or "Rosa helped chop the vegetables today'' beside the soup recipe.
For Rosa,
these recipes were memories of their childhood.
For Lisa, they were a chance
to connect with her grandmother and reconnect with her brother and
sister.
She felt a mix of regret and hope.
Lisa and Rosa decided to try making some of the dishes, but they needed
to invite Marco.
◆◆◆◆◆
Marco had just gotten home from work when the phone rang.
When he
heard Lisa's voice, he was surprised because he hadn't heard from his sister in
years.
At first, he wasn't sure what to think.
He had always wanted to make
their grandmother's dishes but felt
it might be too emotional.
It wasn't just
about cooking for him;
it was about remembering someone they
all missed.
Lisa assured him they would do
it together.
Marco thought for a moment.
The memories were happy but also made him feel sad because of the time they

The smell of the meat pie baking filled the house.
Marco and Rosa shared
a look, both remembering their memories with their grandmother.
Lisa was
checking the oven tapping her fingers on the counter．"I hope
it turns out
well,'' she said quietly.
Marco tried to reassure her, saying it would be fine, but
Lisa wanted everything to be perfect.
It was the first time she had made one
of their grandmother's recipes, and she felt a lot of pressure.
For Rosa, it wasn't just about getting the taste right; it was about keeping
memories and traditions alive・She and Marco had learned so much from their
grandmother - not just about cooking but about family・Cooking together had
been a way to keep the family close, sharing values and stories through the
dishes they made

The three of them sat in silence for
a few moments. Then Lisa's eyes

it."
Rosa reached over to squeeze her

He

From that day on, the three of them made it a habit to meet every month
and cook together.
Lisa even started adding her own notes to the recipe book.
The tradition of family cooking was preserved, keeping the memory of their
grandmother alive in every dish they made.
